items.text: The contract preserves absent/malformed/default-disabled behavior, forbidden private/protected/secret/path/report fields, no implicit network/persistence/payload construction, the bounded desktop request and telemetry-panel guard seam, explicit absence of whole-runtime consumer interception, remaining consent/config/allowlist/transport TBDs, and the prohibition on professional, certification, approval, or code-compliance claims.
